item.title: Madonna & Peggy Gou Release ‘I Feel So Free’ Remix: Stream It Now
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got some exciting news for Madonna fans. The Queen of Pop has just dropped a brand new remix of her latest single, 'I Feel So Free', and it's a collaboration with South Korean superstar DJ, Peggy Gou.
[Short music clip of "I Feel So Free" remix plays]
Host: "This bouncy edit has a throwback vibe to the '80s, reminiscent of Stock Aitken Waterman's production style. You can stream it now and get ready to dance.
This remix is part of Madonna's upcoming album, 'Confessions II', which is her 15th studio album and the follow-up to her 2005 classic, 'Confessions On a Dancefloor'. The original 'I Feel So Free' was released on April 17, and the album's tracklist was recently announced through a clever guerrilla marketing campaign.
[Short music clip of "I Feel So Free" original version plays]
Host: "The tracklist for 'Confessions II' features 12 tracks, including 'I Feel So Free', 'Good for the Soul', 'One Step Away', and many more. We can't wait to hear the full album.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest music news for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update."
